tasks.title: Update Cross-References in Bible Subdivisions Collection
tasks.description: Update cross-references from [BX.Y] format to [BX.Y.Z-section-name] format in bible_subdivisions collection.
tasks.details:
1. Query bible_subdivisions collection for documents containing [BX.Y] references
2. Use find/replace to update format to [BX.Y.Z-section-name]
3. Apply basic validation (check pattern format)
4. Create simple markdown list of updated references
5. HD will manually spot-check results
tasks.testStrategy: Manual verification by HD - spot-check sample of updated documents
